question: Rahul’s age is three times the age of his daughter. After 8 years from now, his age will be 5 years more than twice the age of his daughter. Find the present age of Rahul.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Rahul's age be 3 units and his daughter's age be 1 unit.

After 8 years, Rahul's age is 2 times her age plus 5 years.

Equating directly: 3 units + 8 = 2 × (1 unit + 8) + 5

3 units + 8 = 2 units + 21 ⇒ 1 unit = 13

Rahul's present age = 3 units = 3 × 13 = 39 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 39 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Rahul's age is three times his daughter's age.

⇒ After 8 years, his age will be 5 years more than twice the age of his daughter.

 
 
 Present
 Rahul = 3x
 Daughter = x
 
 
 
• 
 

 + 8 years
 
 
 
 Future (+8 yrs)
 Rahul = 3x + 8
 Daughter = x + 8
 
 
 
 Condition: 3x + 8 = 2(x + 8) + 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the present age of the daughter be x years.

⇒ Present age of Rahul = 3x

⇒ Age of daughter after 8 years = x + 8

⇒ Age of Rahul after 8 years = 3x + 8

⇒ According to the condition: 3x + 8 = 2 × (x + 8) + 5

⇒ 3x + 8 = 2x + 16 + 5

⇒ 3x + 8 = 2x + 21

⇒ 3x − 2x = 21 − 8

⇒ x = 13

⇒ Daughter's present age = 13 years

⇒ Rahul's present age = 3x = 3 × 13 = 39 years

**∴ The correct answer is 39 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The absolute difference in ages between any two individuals always remains exactly the same, regardless of how many years pass backward or forward.

Cross-Multiplication Trick

When comparing ages represented as initial and final ratios over a fixed period of time, cross-multiplying the ratios simplifies finding the base value of 1 ratio unit rapidly.

Average Age Expansion

If the average age of a group of n persons is A, then after k years, the new average age logically becomes exactly A + k without recalculating individual totals.
